partners.diseaseBName: congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 3-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: SERPINA6 (HGNC:10775) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal external genitalia (HP:0000019); HSD3B2 (HGNC:5165) —DISRUPTS→ pregnenolone (CHEBI:17794); pregnenolone (CHEBI:17794) —DECREASES→ steroid hormone biosynthesis (GO:0008201); steroid hormone biosynthesis (GO:0008201) —LEADS_TO→ Ambiguous genitalia (HP:0000083).
